_note: Platform-neutral focusOrder= traversal resolution. A disabled control is always OUT of keyboard traversal (index -1), regardless of any authored order. Otherwise a finite integer focusOrder is the explicit traversal index, and anything absent or non-finite leaves the element at its toolkit default (null = no explicit index). The web maps the result to tabIndex; the native focus engines map it at M1/D1.

cases.name: positive order becomes the explicit index
zero is a valid explicit index
a disabled control leaves traversal even with an authored order
a disabled control with no order is also out of traversal
no focusOrder leaves the toolkit default
an explicit negative order is honored when enabled
